preheader: Prudentia returns to the turf at Tauranga this Saturday carrying a lightweight 54.0kg from Barrier 1, following a full recovery from recent foot soreness.
title: Tauranga Return: Prudentia Primed for Saturday

hero_caption: PRUDENTIA CANTERING FREELY IN HER WORKOUT WITH PROTECTIVE PADS FITTED TO HER FRONT FEET.
standfirst: After a minor hoof-soreness setback that kept her out of action earlier in the month, Prudentia has trotted up 100% sound, galloped impressively with stablemate Ribkraka, and officially accepted for Saturday's BM75 event at Tauranga.
body_1: We are pleased to report that Prudentia has made a complete recovery from the mild front-foot soreness that interrupted her campaign two weeks ago. Under the expert guidance of Lance O'Sullivan and Andrew Scott at Wexford Stables, her fitness was seamlessly maintained through a dedicated swimming regimen before she successfully transitioned back to track gallops. To ensure her comfort, the farrier has fitted protective pads to both front feet.
body_2: Her recent work has been highly encouraging. On Monday morning, she cantered on the sand track displaying a fluid, comfortable, and sound stride. This was backed up by a sharp grass-track gallop alongside stablemate Ribkraka, where both horses worked through their lines with excellent pace and pullup clean. The trainers are confident she has not lost any of her core racing conditioning and is entering Saturday's race in top physical order.
body_3: Prudentia lines up in Race 7, the Super Liquor Greerton (BM75) over 1400m at Tauranga at 4:21 PM. She has drawn the inside rail (Barrier 1) and will carry the absolute minimum weight of 54.0kg. Jockey Masa Hashizume is booked to ride. Given her past success at Tauranga—the venue of her maiden win—and her strong pedigree on wet, winter turf, we are expecting a highly competitive performance.

quote.text: “She is out having a canter and looks a lot more comfortable today. She had sore feet last week but she had a couple of pads put on both of them. We're on target to be at Tauranga on the 27th.”
quote.author: — Andrew Scott

cards.title: Minimum Weight
cards.text: Prudentia carries just 54.0kg, giving away up to 5.5kg to top-weight Principled. This weight advantage is critical on testing winter turf.

cards.title: Comfort Restored
cards.text: The addition of protective front pads has completely resolved her earlier soreness, restoring her characteristic fluid and relaxed stride.

cards.title: The Rail Advantage
cards.text: Drawn in Barrier 1, Masa Hashizume has options to save ground along the rail or seek better winter going out wide as the track shifts.

cards.title: Track & Conditions
cards.text: Tauranga is where she won her maiden. She loves the tight turns and excels on the soft-to-heavy winter footing expected this Saturday.

email_teaser_body: Prudentia makes her highly anticipated return to the track this Saturday in the Super Liquor Greerton (BM75) at Tauranga. Having fully recovered from minor foot soreness, she looks comfortable in her work, carries minimum weight from Barrier 1, and gets conditions to suit on her favorite turning winter track.
